name: fmp_available_exchanges
description:
Stock exchanges covered by FMP, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/available-exchanges as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the values as the exchange filter of fmp_stock_screener; trading hours: fmp_market_hours.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
